items.title: Preparing for the future AI cryptography break
items.description: Rumors say AI could break encryption like RSA. Learn what a real break would mean and how a cryptography inventory helps you prepare. Category: News

items.title: Black Friday + Cyber Monday: 50% off AI external network pentests
items.description: Aikido external network pentests are 50% off through December 1. AI agents attack your perimeter from one domain and report only what they exploited. Category: News

items.title: What we learned from benchmarking ARTEX
items.description: We ran ARTEX and Aikido's external network pentest on the same test environment. Aikido reported 31 findings against 13 for ARTEX, including 11 critical. Category: News

items.title: Response readiness starts before the next 2shell appears
items.description: Attackers now exploit new CVEs within hours. Learn how connecting your cloud, containers and domains ahead of time lets you find affected assets in minutes. Category: News

items.title: Deep Review: secure every commit
items.description: Learn how Aikido's Deep Review reasons about your pull requests to find bugs, quality and security issues in your code before your merge. Category: Product Updates

items.title: What is continuous automated red teaming?
items.description: Continuous automated red teaming simulates real attacks to test whether defenses detect and stop it. Here’s what it involves and how to implement it. Category: Guides & Best Practices

items.title: Attackers use Hugging Face’s AI to make phishing pages
items.description: We found 42 phishing pages on Hugging Face Spaces, many built by prompting an AI website builder. All of them are offline now. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats

items.title: What the ARTEX attacks tell defenders about AI pentesting
items.description: The FBI warned that attackers are using ARTEX, an open-source AI pentesting framework. Here is what it means for defenders and for teams weighing a build. Category: News

items.title: Hardened container images: STIGs, FIPS and FedRAMP explained
items.description: Learn what makes a container image hardened, and how DISA STIGs, FIPS 140, NIST and FedRAMP fit together for teams in and outside federal work. Category: News

items.title: AI incidents of 2026: Rogue agents, stolen keys, and other familiar stories
items.description: We reviewed 50 AI-related security incidents from 2026. Most came down to exposed secrets, over-scoped access, weak isolation and compromised vendors. Category: News

items.title: Aikido launches agentic pentesting for iOS apps
items.description: Aikido now pentests iOS apps. Test your iOS and Android apps and the backend they share in one whitebox AI pentest, with AutoFix and retests. Category: Company Updates

items.title: Ruby2Shell: critical Ruby RCE, affected versions and how to fix it (CVE-2026-132825)
items.description: Ruby2Shell is a critical Ruby flaw that can give attackers code execution. See affected versions, whether GitLab is hit, and how to upgrade and fix it. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats

items.title: PHP critical security release, 19 November (CVE-2026-129289, CVE-2026-115560)
items.description: PHP’s 19 November 2026 security release fixes 18 CVEs, including CVE-2026-115560. See fixed versions, whether you’re affected and how to patch. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats

items.title: Aikido's Deep Review finds Java4Shell in the PR that introduced it
items.description: We recreated the 2021 OpenJDK pull request behind Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) and ran Deep Review on it. It flagged the bug and suggested the upstream fix. Category: News

items.title: nginx2root: Critical nginx vulnerabilities, including one RCE [CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123634, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-113425]
items.description: nginx2root is five critical nginx RCE vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-123007 in HTTP/2. Check if you’re affected and update to nginx 1.31.9 or 1.30.7. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats

items.title: Java4Shell: RCE flaw in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder, with affected versions and fix (CVE-2026-114938)
items.description: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) is an RCE flaw in OpenJDK’s Base64 decoder. See affected versions, fixed builds and the -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics mitigation. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats

items.title: Two malicious agent-framework releases hit PyPI in 33 minutes
items.description: Two malicious agent-framework releases on PyPI ran a credential stealer on every Python start, targeting Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions secrets. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats

items.title: Top 8 Upwind Security alternatives for code and cloud security
items.description: Compare eight Upwind alternatives for code, cloud and runtime security, with a side-by-side table and a shortlist for each buying situation. Category: DevSec Tools & Comparisons

items.title: Top 9 Qualys alternatives for infrastructure and application security
items.description: Compare the top 9 Qualys alternatives for 2026, from Aikido, Tenable and Rapid7 to Wiz, Orca and Snyk, by cloud, code and remediation coverage. Category: DevSec Tools & Comparisons

items.title: Critical Apache HTTP Server vulnerability can allow remote code execution (CVE-2026-119618)
items.description: CVE-2026-119618 is a critical mod_http2 RCE in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.55 to 2.4.70. See who is affected, how to fix it, and how to disable HTTP/2. Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats
